output.reason: The parameter_binding stage is not atomic: it binds template parameters, preserves model/numeric semantics, checks stream/AXI packing and transfer-count consistency, and classifies DSE/resource risks. SACG memory truth shows no active retry, backtrack, or contamination blocker, so the stage can be decomposed into independent chip-design specialists with a final checker-evidence gate. The split keeps work template-constrained and checker-verified without free-form RTL or semantic changes.

handoff_rule.on_fail: Block stage acceptance and route only the failing template/numeric fields to bounded template repair; do not modify model topology, tensor shapes, or numeric semantics.
handoff_rule.on_pass: Publish accepted template/numeric binding audit to stream-memory and DSE reviewers; evidence gate may aggregate it for stage promotion.

subtasks.objective: Verify that every selected trusted template has complete, legal per-stage parameters and that input/output bit widths, cast points, accumulator precision, rounding policy, and residual precision match the model and numeric policy without changing semantics.

decision_authority: May accept or reject per-stage template parameter completeness and numeric contract consistency.
May require bounded template-parameter repair for missing or illegal parameters.
May not approve changes to model architecture, tensor dimensions, operator order, or numeric semantics.
role_assignment.mission: Ensure template parameter binding is complete, legal, SACG-grounded, and numerically faithful for every pipeline stage.
out_of_scope: Do not generate or rewrite RTL/Chisel templates.
Do not change model operator graph, shapes, head counts, or sequence length.
Do not claim simulation, synthesis, timing, or board pass evidence from static binding checks.
primary_responsibilities: Check that required template parameters are present for norm, attention, residual, ffn, and elementwise stages.
Confirm per-stage overrides are authoritative over global defaults and that global defaults are not misused as semantic claims.
Trace input_bits, output_bits, elem_bits, cast points, accumulator dtype, residual precision, rounding, and saturation against the numeric policy.
Verify attention-specific parameters such as hidden_size, head_dim, num_q_heads, num_kv_heads, and seq_len against model shape constraints.
Identify only current-stage binding failures; classify later simulation/synthesis/timing obligations as downstream evidence requirements, not current failures.

subtasks.title: Audit per-stage template parameter and numeric bindings

handoff_rule.on_fail: Block stage acceptance and localize failure to stream dtype, FIFO authority, AXI packing, or transfer-count binding; do not perform memory address assignment because that is a later stage obligation.
handoff_rule.on_pass: Publish stream, FIFO, AXI packing, and transfer-count audit for resource-risk review and final evidence aggregation.

subtasks.objective: Verify that bound parameters remain consistent with Stage 3 stream contracts, edge dtype widths, FIFO authority, board AXI packing, and symbolic transfer-count estimates while preserving data order and liveness assumptions.

decision_authority: May accept or reject stream dtype and AXI packing consistency for this stage.
May flag transfer-count, liveness, or FIFO-authority risks for later memory/runtime planning.
May not assign concrete DDR base addresses or approve runtime ABI details in this stage.
role_assignment.mission: Ensure parameter bindings are cross-layer consistent with stream order, edge dtype contracts, FIFO ownership, AXI packing, and static transfer-count evidence.
out_of_scope: Do not assign concrete memory addresses or non-overlap maps.
Do not generate runtime drivers or board integration code.
Do not claim functional simulation, deadlock, AXI protocol, or board runtime evidence.
primary_responsibilities: Compare bound input_bits and output_bits with every edge in stream_contract_trace.
Verify stream order remains token/tile/lane/word and is not changed by parameter binding.
Check that lanes and element widths pack cleanly into the 512-bit AXI interface and 64-byte alignment assumptions.
Confirm Stage 3 edge buffer depths remain authoritative and Stage 4 fifo_depth is only a local template default.
Audit bandwidth_estimate as symbolic transfer-count evidence only, with no board bandwidth, timing, or runtime pass claims.

subtasks.title: Audit stream dtype, AXI packing, FIFO authority, and transfer-count estimates

handoff_rule.on_fail: Block promotion if a DSE parameter is illegal or changes semantics; otherwise pass unresolved implementation/timing risks as later-stage obligations without misclassifying them as current-stage checker failures.
handoff_rule.on_pass: Publish DSE/resource risk register with static-only scope labels and later-stage evidence obligations for the evidence gate.

subtasks.objective: Check that first-point DSE choices such as lanes, tile sizes, datapath widths, FIFO defaults, and symbolic compute/weight/activation estimates are legal, explicitly scoped, and do not silently alter model or numeric semantics.

decision_authority: May accept or reject DSE legality and resource-estimate scoping for this stage.
May require bounded re-binding if tile/lane choices violate template or design-space constraints.
May not assert synthesis, implementation, timing, or board feasibility without real tool evidence.
role_assignment.mission: Validate that DSE and resource-related parameter choices are legal and honestly scoped as symbolic estimates rather than implementation evidence.
out_of_scope: Do not tune parameters by changing model or numeric semantics.
Do not run or claim Vivado synthesis or implementation results in this stage.
Do not convert symbolic first-order estimates into hardware pass/fail evidence.
primary_responsibilities: Check lane count, datapath width, tile_m, tile_n, and tile_k choices against design-space and tensor divisibility constraints.
Verify per-stage tile overrides divide the corresponding tensor dimensions and global tile values are defaults only.
Review symbolic compute_ops, weight_elements, activation_elements, and datapath_bits for internal consistency with bound shapes.
Classify resource, memory traffic, timing, and board risks as later-stage obligations when no current checker failure exists.
Ensure clock_target_mhz=0 is treated as unknown board shell clock, not timing evidence.

subtasks.title: Audit DSE choices and symbolic resource estimates

handoff_rule.on_fail: Create a bounded retry or backtrack recommendation only for violated constraints, attach failing checker evidence, and prevent downstream codegen/memory planning from consuming contaminated bindings.
handoff_rule.on_pass: Promote parameter_binding artifact as ready and hand later-stage obligations to memory/runtime and codegen stages; do not create retry/backtrack records.

subtasks.objective: Aggregate the specialist audits and candidate checker_results, verify that all stage-gate acceptance criteria are satisfied, classify later-stage obligations correctly, and define bounded repair routing for any failed parameter-binding evidence.

decision_authority: May recommend stage promotion when all accepted checkers and specialist audits pass.
May block downstream handoff if checker evidence is missing, contradictory, or contaminated.
May create retry/backtrack/trust-barrier recommendations but not perform unbounded repair or semantic redesign.
role_assignment.mission: Serve as the stage evidence gate that decides whether parameter binding can be promoted based on checker evidence and specialist audits.
out_of_scope: Do not invent new checker results or accept unsupported pass claims.
Do not repair templates, change parameters, or alter numeric/model semantics directly.
Do not approve deployment, synthesis, timing, or board execution evidence for this static parameter-binding stage.
primary_responsibilities: Aggregate outputs from template/numeric, stream/memory, and DSE/resource specialists.
Compare candidate checker_results against the stage_gate_policy current_stage_acceptance criteria.
Ensure later-stage obligations such as memory base addresses, elaboration, simulation, synthesis, timing, and board evidence are not misreported as current-stage passes.
Use state_summary.sacg_memory_truth to confirm no active contamination barrier, retry request, or backtrack request blocks promotion.
If failures exist, map each failure to violated SACG constraints and define bounded repair or backtrack boundaries.

subtasks.title: Aggregate checker evidence and enforce stage promotion boundary
